metadata.name: Quadrant Mirrored Spectrum
metadata.author: Stateless Preset Designer
metadata.description: Dual frequency spectrum lines composed into 'myframe' with directional ping-pong feedback wind flowing outward from the X and Y axes, plus adaptive moving-average RMS-normalized jagged lightning strikes that slowly fade out over time, rendered with a vibrant 80s neon beach palette (hot pink, sunset orange, and electric tropical blue) replicated across 4 symmetric quadrants, featuring relaxed ~100ms attack-decay beat-reactive zoom bounce and angular twist on the master output canvas.

children.label: myline (Bottom Spectrum Line - 80s Neon Beach Sunset)
myline (Right Spectrum Line - 80s Ocean to Sunset)
myline (RMS Lightning Strike - Neon Pink Flash)

params.initCode: n = 160; avgRms = 0.3; prevSurge = 0.0; surgeThreshold = 0.10; minRms = 0.12; strike = 0.0; seed = 1.0; decay = 0.965; edgeA = 0; edgeB = 2; uA = 0.0; uB = 0.0; x0 = 0.0; y0 = 1.0; x1 = 0.0; y1 = -1.0; dx = 0.0; dy = -2.0; len = 2.0; nx = 1.0; ny = 0.0;
params.frameCode: avgRms = avgRms * 0.992 + $RMS * 0.008; surge = $RMS - avgRms; isStrike = (surge >= surgeThreshold) and (prevSurge < surgeThreshold) and ($RMS > minRms) ? 1.0 : 0.0; prevSurge = surge; strike = isStrike ? 1.0 : (strike * decay); seed = isStrike ? (seed + 19.37) : seed; edgeA = isStrike ? floor(random(4)) : edgeA; edgeB = isStrike ? ((edgeA + 1 + floor(random(3))) % 4) : edgeB; uA = isStrike ? (-0.85 + random(1.7)) : uA; uB = isStrike ? (-0.85 + random(1.7)) : uB; x0 = isStrike ? (edgeA == 0 ? uA : (edgeA == 1 ? 1.0 : (edgeA == 2 ? uA : -1.0))) : x0; y0 = isStrike ? (edgeA == 0 ? 1.0 : (edgeA == 1 ? uA : (edgeA == 2 ? -1.0 : uA))) : y0; x1 = isStrike ? (edgeB == 0 ? uB : (edgeB == 1 ? 1.0 : (edgeB == 2 ? uB : -1.0))) : x1; y1 = isStrike ? (edgeB == 0 ? 1.0 : (edgeB == 1 ? uB : (edgeB == 2 ? -1.0 : uB))) : y1; dx = x1 - x0; dy = y1 - y0; len = max(0.001, sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)); nx = -dy / len; ny = dx / len; linesize = strike > 0.001 ? (1.5 + strike * 5.0) : 0.0; r = strike > 0.001 ? 1.0 : 0.0; g = strike * 0.25; b = strike * 0.85; a = strike;
params.pointCode: envelope = sin(i * PI); h1 = sin(i * 37.0 + seed); h2 = sin(i * 89.0 + seed * 2.3); h3 = sin(i * 211.0 + seed * 4.7); h4 = sin(i * 433.0 + seed * 8.9); jagged = (h1 * 0.12 + h2 * 0.07 + h3 * 0.035 + h4 * 0.015) * envelope; x = x0 + dx * i + nx * jagged; y = y0 + dy * i + ny * jagged; r = strike; g = strike * (0.15 + 0.35 * (1.0 - i)); b = strike * (0.75 + 0.25 * i); a = strike;
